description: Compatibility alias for add_sending_domain. Adds a sending domain and returns the DNS records required for setup. The domain cannot be moved to another company afterwards; confirm the target company first.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

mailFromPrefix.description: Optional return-path (MAIL FROM) subdomain label, default rp. New domains also get a second return path, usually <label>2 (rp2 by default); publish the returned names. One DNS label of 1 to 63 letters, numbers or hyphens; inbound is reserved. Applies only when the domain is created.

trackingPrefix.description: Optional label of the company tracking domain created under the domain (<label>.<domain>, or <label>.<root> when it equals mailFromPrefix), default links (links2 to links5 are tried if it is taken). Used only when the company has no tracking domain yet; ignored otherwise. inbound is reserved. Change it later with set_tracking_domain.

name: add_website

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `add_website` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

website.description: The Sending domain with its cohort-specific DNS records. Publish the DKIM record (for newer domains, the dnsRecords.platformDnsRecords CNAMEs instead: active and spare DKIM selectors plus a recommended return-path CNAME; only required entries block verification), the bounce records described by bounceRecords (cnameRecord when style is cname, otherwise spf.record and mailFrom.mxRecord, never both) and DMARC when present; trackingRecord is the optional company tracking domain CNAME. tracking {policy, required, hostname, status, ready, error, cnameRecord} reports the company tracking domain (policy is always legacy and required always false; deprecated). record returned by Sequenzy.
